federated.honest_note: Demo ran on this VM only, with 3 local partitions. No second live device took part; the linux-box and phone clients are local partitions standing in for those devices.

limits: Triage only. The federated model ranks findings by how much they look like past candidates that survived triage. It does not verify anything.
Zero verified-real positives exist in the training data, so the model never predicts VERIFIED_REAL and must never be used to claim one.

Federated training trades accuracy for privacy: raw findings never leave a device, so the global model sees no centralised data. If it scores below the central baseline, that gap is the privacy cost, not a bug to hide.
Findings from plugins or chains unseen in training fall into the OTHER bucket.
